comparison.objective: Identify the thin-walled tube among three look-alike cylinders; candidate adjusts and validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Discriminative inspection or physical probing of hollow cylinders versus hex-key alignment, collar rotation, counterholding, tightening, and repeated impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: The thin-walled tube must be selected; candidate requires two safe stops and a locked setting below a drift tolerance. No detailed identification rubric/spec is available.
comparison.reason: Material/geometry discrimination is a different tested ability from response-driven commissioning.
